checklist.title: Document correct wage periods and timely payment
checklist.detail: Review payment timelines under the Code on Wages and applicable rules.

checklist.title: Check notified minimum wage for each category
checklist.detail: Check appropriate government, skill category, zone and latest notification.

checklist.title: Review the statutory wages definition and 50% exclusions
checklist.detail: Review section 2(y) and all relevant component classifications.

checklist.title: Check overtime eligibility, hours and supporting records
checklist.detail: Review applicable Code and OSH rules for role/establishment.

checklist.title: Review bonus eligibility and limits
checklist.detail: Verify Code on Wages eligibility, wage ceilings and accounting conditions.

checklist.title: Monitor lawful deductions and pay slips
checklist.detail: Inspect deductions, wage records and applicable rules.

checklist.title: Review worker classification and covered establishments
checklist.detail: Distinguish workers and employees as legally defined.

checklist.title: Review standing orders if industrial establishment is covered
checklist.detail: The 300-worker reference requires scope, establishment and rules checks.

checklist.title: Set up a grievance redressal mechanism where required
checklist.detail: Check headcount, worker category and Code/Rules requirements.

checklist.title: Verify union negotiation and recognition process
checklist.detail: Check registered unions, member support and legal procedures.

checklist.title: Maintain dispute-management and consultation records
checklist.detail: Use applicable dispute resolution procedure and time limits.

checklist.title: Review retrenchment/closure approvals when applicable
checklist.detail: Do not apply a threshold without checking the chapter and establishment.

checklist.title: Check EPF applicability and contribution records
checklist.detail: 20 is an important general threshold; conditions and notifications vary.

checklist.title: Check ESI applicability and insurable employees
checklist.detail: Verify latest threshold, wages ceiling, area and hazardous establishment rules.

checklist.title: Review gratuity eligibility and fixed-term treatment
checklist.detail: General and fixed-term eligibility conditions should not be conflated.

checklist.title: Review maternity benefits and protected leave
checklist.detail: Check applicable chapter and establishment coverage.

checklist.title: Review statutory employee compensation exposure
checklist.detail: A group personal accident policy is not automatically a statutory substitute.

checklist.title: Review gig/platform or unorganised-worker duties where relevant
checklist.detail: Applicable schemes and aggregator provisions must be checked.

checklist.title: Issue employment appointment letters where applicable
checklist.detail: Verify form, timelines and sector-specific requirements.

checklist.title: Maintain occupational health and safety arrangements
checklist.detail: Industry, hazards and thresholds alter obligations.

checklist.title: Check working time, breaks, holidays and leave
checklist.detail: Verify statutory eligibility and relevant state/central rules.

checklist.title: Review annual health check-up obligations
checklist.detail: Check age/worker category and notified rules.

checklist.title: Review contract labour registration and licensing applicability
checklist.detail: Check threshold, notified rules and principal employer responsibilities.

checklist.title: Review inter-state migrant-worker protections
checklist.detail: Coverage may include self-migrated workers; verify conditions.

checklist.title: Review consent and safeguards for night work by women
checklist.detail: Do not treat permission as unconditional; verify consent and safeguards.

checklist.title: Review accident notifications, registers and safety records
checklist.detail: Applicable processes, registers and notifications vary.
